description: feign is a Python package for estimating the geometric efficiency of passive gamma-spectroscopy measurements of spent nuclear-fuel assemblies. It represents the measurement setup with a two-dimensional point-kernel method and helps compare detector placement or assembly geometry. Users provide the fuel and detector configuration, so spatial coverage is the measurement setup and the time span follows a chosen inspection; the package does not publish measured spectra. Its public repository and instructions are MIT licensed. Efficiency estimates can help plan verification of nuclear-fuel inventories and calibration of measurement simulations. A caveat is that the method omits some photon build-up effects, and an efficiency calculation alone does not establish fuel burnup, cooling time or diversion. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS article and own README were read without processing a spectrum or simulating a facility.
